INSERT INTO slot_sessions (assignment_id, slot_id, session_number, start_at, end_at, status, venue_id, capacity_groups, enrolled_groups, assign_mode, is_published_to_examiner, is_published_to_student, is_staffed, created_at, updated_at) VALUES
(#{s.assignmentId}, #{s.slotId}, #{s.sessionNumber}, #{s.startAt}, #{s.endAt}, #{s.status}, #{s.venueId}, #{s.capacityGroups}, #{s.enrolledGroups}, #{s.assignMode}, #{s.isPublishedToExaminer}, #{s.isPublishedToStudent}, #{s.isStaffed}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM slot_sessions WHERE slot_id = #{slotId} ORDER BY session_number ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE slot_sessions SET status = 'booked', booked_subject_id = #{bookedSubjectId}, booked_subject_type = #{bookedSubjectType}, booked_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'available'
UPDATE slot_sessions SET status = 'available', booked_subject_id = NULL, booked_subject_type = NULL, booked_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'booked'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM slot_sessions WHERE slot_id = #{slotId} AND status = 'booked'
SELECT ss.* FROM slot_sessions ss WHERE ss.assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND ss.status = 'available' ORDER BY ss.start_at ASC, ss.session_number ASC
SELECT ss.* FROM slot_sessions ss WHERE ss.assignment_id = #{assignmentId} ORDER BY ss.start_at ASC, ss.session_number ASC

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM slot_sessions ss LEFT JOIN ( SELECT session_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM session_examiners GROUP BY session_id ) se ON se.session_id = ss.session_id WHERE ss.assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND ss.is_published_to_student = 1 AND (se.c IS NULL OR se.c = 0)

SELECT ss.* FROM slot_sessions ss INNER JOIN time_slots ts ON ss.slot_id = ts.slot_id WHERE ts.assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND ss.status = 'booked' AND ss.booked_subject_type = 'STUDENT' AND ss.booked_subject_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY ts.start_at ASC, ss.session_number ASC

SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM slot_sessions ss INNER JOIN time_slots ts ON ss.slot_id = ts.slot_id WHERE ts.assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND ss.status = 'booked' AND ( (ss.booked_subject_type = 'STUDENT' AND ss.booked_subject_id = #{studentId}) OR (ss.booked_subject_type = 'GROUP' AND ss.booked_subject_id IN ( SELECT sg.group_id FROM sys_student_group sg WHERE sg.user_id = #{studentId} )) )

SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM slot_sessions ss INNER JOIN time_slots ts ON ss.slot_id = ts.slot_id WHERE ts.assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND ss.status = 'booked' AND ss.booked_subject_type = 'GROUP' AND ss.booked_subject_id = #{groupId}
